text:
Kara: Quick brainstorm: want to reconcile two ideas 1) short-lived escrows (predictive credits) and 2) conservative leases. How do we stitch them so fairness + auditability stay intact?

Ibrahim: Basics: leases are authoritative small allocations with TTL. Escrows are speculative, short TTL, and revokable. Use escrows for burst smoothing, but require leases for steady-state heavy usage.

Noelle: Agree. Add invariant: total outstanding escrows + committed leases must not exceed global_budget + epsilon. Epsilon should be tiny and configurable per deployment.

Kara: Operationally, edges check local lease first, then use escrow if available. If neither, consult central or soft-shed.

Ibrahim: Revocation path is critical. Central publishes revoke messages on a low-latency channel. Edges must stop using matching escrow_id immediately and decrement soft balances.

Noelle: What about reconciliation? Central writes ADJUST records to ledger after actual usage. ADJUSTs correct cost differences and record model_id used for billing.

Kara: Failure mode: central unreachable. Plan: edges fall back to token-bucket based on last-known lease and disallow new escrows. Emit telemetry high-sample for any fallback admissions.

Ibrahim: For privacy/Private deploys, make escrows optional and allow local-only escrows where the customer keeps the escrow logic entirely inside the VPC.

Noelle: Telemetry list we need: escrow_grant, escrow_use, escrow_revoke, lease_grant, lease_use, fallback_local_admit, ledger_lag_ms, adjust_applied. Sample rates vary by client size.

dex-ops: Ops notes: alert if revoke_apply_latency_p95 > 200ms OR ledger_consumer_lag_1m > 10s. Playbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/escrow-lease-failures

ops-bot: :warning: Suggested alert rule: (revoke_apply_p95 > 200ms) OR (ledger_consumer_lag_1m > 10s) -> Pager.

Kara: API sketches (light): POST /v1/escrow/grant {client_id, region, cost_hint} -> {escrow_id, cost, expires_at, version} POST /v1/lease/request {client_id, prefix_hash} -> {lease_tokens, expires_at, version} Edges include escrow_id or lease_version in admits.

Ibrahim: Rollout: 1) shadow mode where we emit escrows but edges ignore them; 2) allow escrow usage for 1% traffic in canary; 3) increase while monitoring ADJUST noise and dispute rates.

Noelle: Migration note: always run ledger in write-only mode first and keep current tokenbank for enforcement until divergence < threshold. Then cutover.

Kara: Decision for now: prototype hybrid (leases + optional escrows) in staging. RFC will include schema, revoke channel design, and exact invariants.

Ibrahim: I'll prototype revoke pubsub and quick-apply logic.

Noelle: I'll write reconcile tests for ADJUSTs and billing hooks.

Kara: Thanks. Target RFC draft by next Wed. :thumbsup:
